text.en:
Pasong Putik Elementary School located at St. Dominic Subdivision, Barangay Kaligayahan,
Quezon City, Metropolitan Manila, is hereby named Delfin Geraldez Memorial Elementary School in honor
of the late Delfin Geraldez, a philanthropist who donated the lot where the school is now located.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 13, 1984
